description: Create an empty plugin in the project. Without `slug` the server derives one from the name. A `slug` is refused, writing nothing, with code `plugin_slug_conflict` (409: another plugin of the project has it), `plugin_slug_forbidden` (a reserved slug), `plugin_slug_locked` (the slug of this plugin cannot be changed) or `plugin_slug_invalid` (not a valid slug).

description.description: The new plugin's description, at most 25000 characters.

name.description: The new plugin's name, at most 200 characters.

slug.description: The new plugin's slug (CLI: --slug). Unique in the project; it is the name of the plugin package and the prefix of its commands.

name: plugins_create
title: Create plugin
